item.title: Northwestern loses to Washington 76-62, falling to 2-9 in the Big Ten with 7th defeat in last 9 games
item.description: Hannes Steinbach, Zoom Diallo and Wesley Yates III combined for 65 points as Washington beat Northwestern 76-62 on Saturday, handing the Wildcats their seventh loss in nine games.

item.title: NBA trade tracker: Chicago Bulls receive Dario Šarić and a pair of 2nd-round picks in 3-team deal

item.title: Asking Eric: Am I a bad friend?
item.description: Dear Eric: I know grieving takes time and everyone is different. When I resisted any more minute-by-minute details, I was told I wasn't a good friend. Am I really a bad friend because I just did not want every detail again? I miss her but I don't miss walking- on-eggshells conversations.

item.title: Short-handed Chicago Bulls — and a white-hot Ayo Dosunmu — outlast Miami Heat 125-118 to snap 3-game skid
item.description: Ayo Dosunmu scored 29 points and Matas Buzelis added 10 of his 21 in the fourth quarter Saturday, leading the Chicago Bulls to a 125-118 win over the Miami Heat.
